_readme: Tell Desk as the site explains it, taken from desk/README.md (keep them in step). The live address comes from data/desk-deployment.json, copied from chain/desk-<network>.json by scripts/contracts.mjs; status flips to live once it has an address.

publicLedger.name: reports
publicLedger.holds: Each report's id, persistentCommit({digest, project}, nonce): a hiding, binding commitment that proves priority. Also its seal time, last change and status
publicLedger.who: Anyone; says a report exists, not what or about whom

publicLedger.name: tag
publicLedger.holds: persistentHash("tell-desk:researcher", secret, id): lets the researcher prove a report is theirs, different for every report

publicLedger.name: maintainers
publicLedger.holds: Credential leaves, persistentHash("tell-desk:maintainer", secret, project), registered once by Tell. Proofs disclose only the root
publicLedger.who: Anyone; hides the secret and the project

publicLedger.name: openings
publicLedger.holds: Digest, project and nonce of a report, only after it is fixed or its embargo passes: the reveal step of a commit-reveal

publicLedger.name: grades
publicLedger.holds: Code hash → grade, rules version and scan, attested by Tell. Self-reported grades live in selfGrades, flagged and kept apart

publicLedger.name: attester
publicLedger.holds: persistentHash("tell-desk:attester", secret): the officer key that attests grades and registers maintainers

privateState.name: report text
privateState.holds: What was found. Only its SHA-256 ever reaches the chain, and only after the reveal

privateState.name: digest, project, nonce
privateState.holds: The opening of the seal: SHA-256 of the text, SHA-256 of the canonical repository URL, 32 random bytes
privateState.who: Researcher and maintainer, until the reveal

privateState.name: researcher secret
privateState.holds: Authorship. Used inside the proof to make and check tags; never leaves the device

privateState.name: maintainer secret
privateState.holds: The credential behind a leaf, plus the Merkle path to it built from the public tree

circuits.name: seal
circuits.does: Records a new report: id, tag, seal time, status pending
circuits.discloses: The commitment and a per-report tag; the text, project and nonce stay private

circuits.name: acknowledge, markFixed
circuits.does: A maintainer proves they hold the opening and a credential for the project it commits to
circuits.discloses: Which report (already public) and a tree root every maintainer shares; not the credential, not the project

circuits.name: reveal
circuits.does: Publishes the opening of a fixed report, or of any report after the 90-day embargo
circuits.discloses: Digest, project and nonce: the point of the reveal

circuits.name: retract
circuits.does: The researcher withdraws a report before it is acknowledged
circuits.discloses: Which report; the proof shows the tag is theirs without naming them

circuits.name: attest, selfGrade
circuits.does: Tell records a grade for a code hash; a registered maintainer may self-report one, flagged
circuits.discloses: The grade, rules version and scan; a self-report names its project

flow.text: The researcher seals the report. The ledger stores a commitment, a per-report tag, the time and status pending. The text goes to the team off chain.
The maintainer proves in zero knowledge that they hold the opening and a credential for that project. Status: acknowledged.
Same proof again once the fix is out. Status: fixed. The chain never said which project it was.
After the fix, or after the 90-day embargo, the opening is published. Anyone with the text can check it against the seal.
Tell attests the contract's grade against its code hash. A wallet computes the code hash from any address and looks it up.
